    The Jaffa Institute

    Breaking the cycle of poverty in Tel Aviv-Jaffa since 1982

    Our MISSION

    • To provide educational and social enrichment to disadvantaged children and community members. 

    ​

    • To increase the nutritional security of impoverished individuals in our service area.
       

    • To care for and strengthen the emotional and mental well-being of our program participants.

    volunteer

    We are always looking for volunteers to help achieve our goals. Whether you are in the US planning your child's Bar or Bat Mitzvah, or want to organize a company trip to our Food Distribution Center in Tel Aviv, there are opportunities to make a difference and help end the cycle of intergenerational poverty.
